description: Switching the AttentionAnimation setting from 1 through 6 in the initial config and at runtime immediately updates each DockItem’s selected type, while inactive animation state keeps its normal value.

assertions.comment: The dock starts normally with the saved Bounce(1) config and shows the four default launchers
The initial config’s Bounce value 1 is reflected in DockItem
The default Bottom dock’s Bounce element is prepared with an upward offset of -14px
Wiggle value 2 is reflected immediately without a restart
Pulse value 3 is reflected immediately without a restart
Glow value 4 is reflected immediately without a restart
The unnamed fixed child path’s Glow MultiEffect exists and is hidden before Attention
DotColor value 5 is reflected immediately without a restart
The DotColor blink property is prepared at the normal opacity 1.0 before Attention
Blink value 6 is reflected immediately without a restart
The Blink property is prepared at the normal opacity 1.0 before Attention
With no Attention input, a style change alone does not falsely start the animation
